Comfort First HVAC
ESTIMATE TOTAL $13,750.00
Install 3-ton heat pump and air handler rated 17 SEER2, 11.7 EER2, and 8.5 HSPF2. Manufacturer: Trane. Outdoor model 4TWR7036A1000. AHRI matched-system certificate included. Manual J load calculation included. Startup and airflow testing included.

Valley Mechanical
PROPOSAL TOTAL $9,200.00
Replace existing gas furnace with a 60,000 BTUH, 96% AFUE furnace. New thermostat and electrical connection included. Permit included. Remove and dispose of old furnace. One-year labor warranty.

Pacific Climate
QUOTE TOTAL $10,500.00
Install 3-ton central air conditioner rated 15.2 SEER2. Existing ductwork and refrigerant line set will be reused. Thermostat not included. Permit and system startup included. AHRI certificate not stated.
